0022600096.text: The Magic host the Timberwolves in Orlando for Orlando's second game of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has a 2026-27 result on record yet. Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). Orlando won both meetings in the 2025-26 season series, most recently a 132-120 regular-season win in Orlando on April 8, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
